blocks.md: **dp[i][w] = best value using first i items within capacity w. Row i depends ONLY on row i-1 -> space-optimize to one row walked right-to-left.**

blocks.label: 0/1 knapsack full + 1D optimized
blocks.py:
# 2D teaching form then 1D optimized (w DESCENDING = 0/1 law)
dp = [0] * (W + 1)
for wt, val in items:
    for w in range(W, wt - 1, -1):     # descending!
        dp[w] = max(dp[w], val + dp[w - wt])
